extensionOnboarding.description: Sandbox connects the frontend part of a JS module by external URL: manifest/descriptor, HTML entrypoint or JS script. It loads resources over the network, attaches stylesheet when available and starts the extension through a worker-compatible endpoint.

steps.devServer: Run your module dev server that serves frontend resources over HTTP.
steps.entrypoint: Provide an entrypoint or descriptor URL: JS script, HTML entrypoint or JSON manifest.
steps.worker: For the current scenario, the entrypoint should run `runEndpoint(defineRunner(...))`, and the descriptor should define `runner: "worker"`, `targets` and/or `pages`.
